notes.title: Anthro Heat Release Plans
notes.notes:
Hey there,



Thank you so much for joining us during Steam Next Fest; we hope you enjoyed the demo! We'll still have the demo available on Steam as we continue working towards the game's release later this year. 



Our team is very committed and making good progress, but Quality comes first. You can follow our development progress on our social networks and also on our Official Discord. Although we don't have a specific release date for the game, we're doing our best to launch it this year! 



In the version we are developing, we already have: 

06 Locations (Suite, Bathroom, Gym, Cabin, Locker Room, and Beach).,

12 Characters (Astera, Atlas, Aurora, Emmy, Garret, Hera, Marina, Riley, Jasper, Sasha, Renée, and Vertex).,

Fixed and improved several gameplay resources, including poses, textures, reported bugs, collisions, dialogues, animations, etc.

And much more!
